title: Von Miller would love Denver return if he doesn't stay with Commanders

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Von Miller would love Denver return if he doesn't stay with Commanders
sources.description: Von Miller had nine sacks with the Commanders last season and he said early in January that his preference would be to remain with the team in 2026.
